status: private independently reviewed; awaiting actual-parent integration
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; pinned raw lexer profile with Zend multibyte disabled
behavior: The pure source compiler derives a complete parser-warning prefix from fresh AST occurrences before ordinary compiler diagnostics/publications. Each admitted root declaration has one string-literal encoding item, ABSENT body and one authenticated physical line. Unsupported later/nested shapes cannot disappear by editing a stored occurrence list.

The new encoding-disabled tag is disjoint from the old default warning-level guard and uses E_COMPILE_WARNING (128). It bypasses registered user handlers. Runtime consumes only the same source-authenticated no-op; preceding declarations are allowed, preceding NOPs are not. Bad placement remains Unsupported rather than claiming a new compile Error.

Dynamic parser admission byte-captures helper stderr and validates the entire accepted-AST encoding-warning stream, including line/count and common parser filename. Eval uses the fixed parser filename; file parsing uses a temporary parser filename, while execution diagnostics derive the actual source filename independently. Unexpected stderr and rejected-with-warning results refuse before adapter resumption; no parser response/schema or shared Worker contract changes.

The native-exact eval original reports encoding line2 before an earlier unknown-declare compiler Warning at1. The include original parses/body-runs once, skips the second include_once without a new unit/diagnostic, then ordinary include reparses/body-runs and reports the second warning.
engine_routes: Zend/zend_compile.c::zend_handle_encoding_declaration runs in the parser and emits E_COMPILE_WARNING (128) when CG(multibyte)==0; zend_compile_declare subsequently checks first statement with allow_nop=false and otherwise leaves encoding as a no-op.
Zend/zend.c error-handler policy excludes compile warnings. Existing source/declaration notice protocols preserve diagnostic order, source filenames and once completion.
native/php_file.c parser-only entrypoints and frontend/FileLexer.php::withPhpSourceFile retain syntax authority only; no Zend application evaluation is added.
preserved_outcomes: The unchanged baseline is accepted-program Unsupported other-declare after B| with only the unknown-declare warning; it has zero agreement credit. Initial affected model35 stopped before runtime at a SpecTec singleton-list syntax error. Whole-file parse-only then found one record PATH grouping issue; both syntax corrections preserve semantic admission and all original failed/parse-only records remain zero. The corrected two sources and current public177 pass at the same five-file runtime/CLI cut; native/preparation/parse-only/refusal observations remain zero credit.
transport_scope: The maintained protocol validates and retains 520 parser stderr bytes across accepted eval/two file responses and one parser-only rejected-with-warning control. Missing/extra/wrong-line/unexpected streams are pure refusal controls; the rejected response is never sent to the adapter. Shared recorded_worker.py remains byte-exact. No new syntax acceptance/configuration, native build or portability claim.
remaining: Multibyte-enabled transcoding, other declaration values/shapes and placement Errors, parser failures with preceding warnings and wider compiler-failure/reentry/diagnostic interactions remain partial. This does not close encoding, declare or dynamic source core.
